propositions: A single criterion's LLMBudgetExhaustedError propagates out of the per-criterion loop in _recover and aborts the entire bounded recovery, discarding all gathered evidence instead of treating it as per-criterion exhaustion.

The per-criterion evidence loop must catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, and token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError; substitute a content-free placeholder entry marking exhausted=true; and continue with remaining criteria rather than failing whole.

Recovery must fail outright only when zero criteria produce evidence, raising CompletionRecoveryError with diagnostic counts; single-criterion exhaustion is a per-criterion safeguard boundary, not an aggregate failure.

The exhausted placeholder must be content-free and unambiguously mark that evidence could not be gathered within bounds, so the finalizer scores the criterion unmet/indeterminate and partial evidence is preserved across all N criteria.
